evaluate_view.py.content_utf8:
from importlib.metadata import version
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
import sys
import lkml

with Path(sys.argv[1]).open(encoding="utf-8") as source:
    definition = lkml.load(source)

view, = definition["views"]
dimension, = view["dimensions"]
assert view["name"] == "hello" and dimension["name"] == "greeting"
assert dimension["type"] == "string"
assert "${TABLE}" in dimension["sql"]
with sqlite3.connect(":memory:") as database:
    alias = '"hello"'
    relation = view["derived_table"]["sql"]
    projection = dimension["sql"].replace("${TABLE}", alias)
    select = f"SELECT {projection} AS greeting FROM ({relation}) AS {alias}"
    rows = database.execute(select).fetchall()
    assert rows == [("Hello, World!",)]
    try:
        database.execute(f"SELECT {alias}.nonexistent FROM ({relation}) AS {alias}")
    except sqlite3.OperationalError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("The projection must resolve in the derived table")
    print(f"lkml {version('lkml')}; SQLite {sqlite3.sqlite_version}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(rows[0][0])
